title: Apps
subtitle: Personal health tools that work offline

vitals-tracker.name: Vitals
vitals-tracker.description: Log blood pressure, sugar, heart rate, and more — your health balance at a glance.

medication-tracker.name: Medication Assistant
medication-tracker.description: Schedule doses, track what you took, and get refill reminders — your daily medication helper.

checkup-planner.name: Checkup Planner
checkup-planner.description: See recommended medical checkups by age, gender, and region.

immunization-tracker.name: Immunization Tracker
immunization-tracker.description: Track vaccines, due dates, and your child's immunization record.

pregnancy-tracker.name: Pregnancy Tracker
pregnancy-tracker.description: Follow your pregnancy week by week, log symptoms, and track milestones.

period-tracker.name: Period Tracker
period-tracker.description: Track cycles, log period days, and see simple predictions.

periodTracker.emptySubtitle: Log your last period to see predictions

general-checkup.name: General medical checkup
general-checkup.description: Yearly visit with a clinician for overall health review.

dental-checkup.name: Dental checkup
dental-checkup.description: Cleaning and oral exam to catch cavities and gum disease early.

eye-exam.name: Eye / vision exam
eye-exam.description: Check vision and eye health; more often if you wear glasses or have diabetes.

blood-pressure.name: Blood pressure check
blood-pressure.description: Screen for hypertension — a silent risk for heart disease and stroke.

blood-sugar.name: Blood sugar / diabetes screen
blood-sugar.description: Fasting glucose or HbA1c, especially with family history or excess weight.

cholesterol.name: Cholesterol / lipid panel
cholesterol.description: Blood test for heart risk. Discuss frequency with your clinician.

weight-bmi.name: Weight & BMI review
weight-bmi.description: Track healthy weight trends as part of your annual checkup.

flu-vaccine.name: Seasonal flu vaccination
flu-vaccine.description: Yearly flu shot where available and recommended.

cervical-screening.name: Cervical screening (Pap / HPV)
cervical-screening.description: Screen for cervical cancer. Follow local guidelines for interval.

mammogram.name: Mammogram
mammogram.description: Breast cancer screening. Start age varies by guideline and risk.

prostate-discussion.name: Prostate health discussion
prostate-discussion.description: Talk with a clinician about PSA testing and prostate symptoms.

prostate-earlier.name: Earlier prostate discussion
prostate-earlier.description: Consider discussing screening earlier if you are of African ancestry or have family history.

colorectal-screening.name: Colorectal cancer screening
colorectal-screening.description: Stool test or colonoscopy starting in mid-adulthood — ask which option fits you.

skin-check.name: Skin check
skin-check.description: Review moles and skin changes with a clinician.

bone-density-women.name: Bone density (DEXA)
bone-density-women.description: Screen for osteoporosis risk after menopause / later adulthood.

bone-density-men.name: Bone density (DEXA)
bone-density-men.description: Screen for osteoporosis risk in later adulthood.

tetanus-booster.name: Tetanus booster review
tetanus-booster.description: Confirm tetanus (and related) boosters are up to date — often every 10 years.

hep-b-birth.name: Hepatitis B
hep-b-birth.description: First dose given at birth or within 24 hours.

opv-0.name: Polio (OPV)

penta-1.name: Pentavalent
penta-1.description: Covers diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B, and Hib.

rota-1.name: Rotavirus
